mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC of FEDFUNDS level with 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day return when FEDFUNDS < 4.0% is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL level above 200 signals persistent inflation, prompting expectations of aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 200, or Rank IC of CPIAUCSL with 20-day returns is not significantly negative (Rank IC > -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly elevated housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, strengthening corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) has Rank IC < 0.03 with 5-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window, or average 5-day return when both HOUST>2100 and RSAFS>350000 is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals tight labor market conditions that drive wage inflation and force aggressive monetary policy, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC of UNRATE with 60-day returns is not significantly negative (Rank IC > -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong residential construction activity, signaling sustained consumer spending and corporate revenue growth that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC of HOUST level with 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or average 60-day return when HOUST > 50th percentile is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 2200 thousand units signals an overheating housing market, accelerating economic momentum and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when HOUST > 2200, or Rank IC of HOUST with 5-day returns is not significantly positive (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly elevated federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) and CPI (CPIAUCSL > 200) signal aggressive monetary tightening amid persistent inflation, increasing equity discount rates and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (FEDFUNDS * CPIAUCSL) has Rank IC < 0.03 with 20-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window, or average 20-day return when both FEDFUNDS>4.5 and CPIAUCSL>200 is not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105) indicates robust manufacturing output and supply chain efficiency, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when INDPRO > 105, or Rank IC of INDPRO with 60-day returns is not significantly positive (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.
